projects.title: Predictive Modeling for Life Insurance Mortality
projects.description: Developing machine learning models to predict mortality rates based on socioeconomic factors in Tanzania.
projects.problemStatement: Current mortality tables do not account for emerging socioeconomic factors in East Africa. This project develops improved predictive models.
objectives: Identify key socioeconomic predictors of mortality
Compare model accuracy with traditional approaches
projects.methodology: Obtained mortality data from WHO, applied logistic regression, random forests, and neural networks.
projects.findings: ML models achieved 89% accuracy, outperforming traditional methods. Age and income are primary predictors.

projects.title: Claims Frequency Analysis in Motor Insurance
projects.description: Statistical analysis of motor insurance claims frequency patterns and their drivers in East Africa.
projects.problemStatement: Insurance companies need better understanding of claims frequency patterns to optimize pricing.
projects.methodology: Analyzed 3 years of claims data, applied Poisson and negative binomial regression models.
projects.findings: Age and vehicle type are significant frequency drivers. Seasonal patterns identified.

projects.title: Pension Fund Sustainability Analysis
projects.description: Analyzing long-term sustainability of defined benefit pension schemes in Tanzania under different economic scenarios.
projects.problemStatement: Many pension schemes face funding challenges due to demographic changes and economic volatility.
objectives: Model pension scheme funding over 30 years
projects.methodology: Built actuarial model using R, applied stochastic simulations to test scenarios.
projects.findings: Current funding levels need adjustment. Recommended gradual contribution increase.

projects.title: Machine Learning for Health Insurance Fraud Detection
projects.description: Building anomaly detection models to identify potentially fraudulent health insurance claims.
projects.problemStatement: Insurance fraud costs the industry millions annually. Early detection can significantly reduce losses.
objectives: Analyze historical claims for fraud patterns
projects.methodology: Used isolation forests, autoencoders, and gradient boosting on labeled claims data.
projects.findings: Combined approach achieved 82% precision and 76% recall on test data.

projects.title: Climate Risk Assessment for Agricultural Insurance
projects.description: Assessing climate-related risks for agricultural insurance products in Tanzania.
projects.problemStatement: Climate change is increasing agricultural risk, requiring new insurance products.
projects.methodology: Combined climate data with crop yields, built stochastic models for insurance pricing.
projects.findings: Climate-indexed insurance can provide affordable coverage for smallholder farmers.

projects.title: Life Insurance Pricing with Big Data
projects.description: Leveraging big data sources for more accurate life insurance pricing.
projects.problemStatement: Traditional life insurance pricing uses limited data, missing important risk factors.
projects.methodology: Integrated traditional actuarial tables with alternative data sources using GLMs.
projects.findings: Enhanced models improved pricing accuracy by 12% while maintaining regulatory compliance.
